cases.reading: Sam LaPorta's available picture centers on elite statistical standing within a thin sample of five appearances, yet this measured performance is set against a backdrop of expressed frustration and a willingness to seek payment elsewhere. The divergence between his high percentile rankings and his reported dissatisfaction creates a tension where on-field contributions do not yet resolve the uncertainty surrounding his future with the Detroit Lions.
